name: Fort Armory
player_description: The armory is locked and guarded. Rufus the smith holds the keys -- as does the Custos Armorum. Equipment is issued here, repaired here, and inventoried daily. Nothing leaves without a signature.
gm_notes: DC 13 Perception: one rack of pila has been disturbed and re-racked out of order -- someone counted them, or removed one. DC 14 Investigation: the inventory log has a corrected entry from three nights ago -- two scuta were logged as 'damaged and removed' but there is no corresponding damage report. DC 15: the correction was made in a different hand than the original entry.
